title: Deserted Mall World
content: I’ve seen lots of posts and comments on this sub describing animals, monsters, or other people in the dreams. Does anybody else have dreams where it’s always 100% deserted? I’m always wandering a vast empty mall where there are no people and most of the shops are closed. The ones that are open are deserted. It’s quite liminal. I feel very, very alone. Occasionally I’ll wander airports, apartment complexes, or huge underground parking garages and these are similarly devoid of people or any other forms of life.
